scoring_justification: The paper's main result is the calculated peak currents and dwell times for four diodes under two models; these values can be compared directly to the paper's Table II values (hidden gold) using relative and absolute tolerances. Recomputing the metrics from raw intermediate artifacts is unnecessary because the gold is the paper's own calculated numbers, and result‑level comparison is the faithful reproduction target.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold peak currents and dwell times from paper Table II
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper Table II, unstarred (Gamma-only) and starred (Gamma+X) rows converted to amperes and seconds
hidden_assets.generation_method: values extracted from paper's Table II for S1, A1, A2, S2 diodes; currents converted from mA/µA to A, dwell times converted from ps/ns to s
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: these are the exact published calculated results from the paper

outputs.description: Table of peak currents (A) and dwell times (s) for diodes S1, A1, A2, S2 under Γ-only and Γ+X tunneling models.
